title: بسته تحویل و پذیرش اولیه کارفرما
acceptanceCriteria: Release/SHA، ورودی، expected، راهنمای نقش‌ها، نمونه‌ها، checksum و نتیجه صریح آزمون کارفرما روی همان نسخه ثبت شود.

personasEvaluated.summary: Observes absence of frozen A.1 release archive, missing SHA-256 digest manifest, and lack of explicit protocol/sign-off mechanism for initial acceptance.
Notes that negative cross-project data leakage tests and direct ID access tests on live endpoints have not been verified in running instances.
Points out that dependencies B01 through B05 remain unresolved with open defects in daily Excel layout, shift hours, and 34/32 occupation mapping.

defects.title: Missing A.1 frozen delivery package (Commit SHA, archive, and SHA-256 checksums)
defects.evidence: No frozen release archive or checksum file exists for Phase A.1. Existing package belongs to legacy A.7 release.

defects.title: Open blocker defects and Strict XFAILs in prerequisite packages B01 through B05
defects.evidence: B06 strictly depends on B01-B05 closure. Previous audits confirmed open defects across data contracts, version integrity, Shiraz parity, and aggregations.

defects.title: Missing client initial acceptance protocol/sign-off mechanism
defects.evidence: Automated tests or agent execution cannot substitute for explicit client acceptance sign-off. Status is currently pending.

defects.title: Unverified live multi-tenant cross-project authorization and direct ID download isolation (Group E09)
defects.evidence: Negative test suite against direct file ID queries across different project IDs has not been verified on a running server instance.

defects.title: Incomplete mobile responsive & bilingual FA/EN verification evidence for end-to-end report workflow (Group Q03)
defects.evidence: Fresh end-to-end execution across desktop/mobile and FA/EN views is missing with servers offline.

summary: Requirement B06 failed QA verification because the frozen release package (Release/SHA, inputs, expected files, checksums) for Phase A.1 is not generated, prerequisite packages B01-B05 remain open with defects, live cross-project authorization on running instances is unverified, and no explicit client initial acceptance protocol is recorded.
